1.official: Hey, Kiryu. Where do you figure Tachibana is now, after you covered his ass all this time?

4.literal: ...Looks like Captain Kazama plans to let you die without lifting a finger, too.
4.official: Looks like Kazama's just gonna sit by and let you die, too.

5.literal: ...I'm gonna enjoy this to the fullest, Kiryu!!
5.official: I'm gonna have some real fun this time, Kiryu!

6.literal: Yeah. But... with this many of you coming along with me,
6.official: True... but at least I know I won't be lonely when I bring all you guys down with me.

7.official: You should do the same. I don't want you on my conscience.

8.literal: You think I'll back down just because you say it like that?

13.literal: Anyway, I need to treat that wound on your head.
13.official: We need to get that head patched up.

14.literal: The wound doesn't look that deep. I'll just disinfect it.
14.official: The cut doesn't look very deep. I'll just clean it.

15.literal: I don't want to make my sworn brother suffer anymore.
15.official: I've done enough... I don't want to hurt a brother.

16.literal: A detective came to this bar today, and
16.official: A detective came in today, saying he wanted to ask you a few questions.

18.literal: That grace period has run out...

19.literal: The elevator shouldn't even be running anymore...!
